newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU officials prepare for ERM lira meeting.
newsitem.headline: EU officials prepare for ERM lira meeting.

text.p: European Union monetary officials were preparing on Friday for a monetary committee meeting on Saturday to discuss the Italian lira's re-entry into the EU's exchange rate mechanism (ERM), an EU source said.
"They are preparing for tomorrow," the source said.
Speculation of a meeting on Saturday was fuelled earlier today when a senior official told Reuters in Frankfurt that the Italian government had requested a meeting of the monetary committee.
Italian central bank governor Antonio Fazio confirmed later that Italy had indeed asked for the lira to re-enter the ERM.
The lira was forced out of the close-knit exchange rate system in 1992.
Membership of Europe's exchange rate mechanism for at least two years prior to the start of monetary union, expected in 1999, is one of the conditions laid down in the Maastricht treaty.
